claim: An OU scientist is the UK lead for BepiColombo’s MIXS X-ray spectrometer.

suggestion.from: An OU scientist is the UK lead for BepiColombo's MIXS X-ray spectrometer, which will map the elements on Mercury's surface.
suggestion.to: OU scientists are Co-Investigators on BepiColombo's MIXS X-ray spectrometer, which will map the elements on Mercury's surface.
